thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Hosted API (us-east) queue growing rapidly, GPU pool utilization at 98%, provisioner returning throttling errors. Auto-scaler failing to create new nodes (rate-limited). Paging sre-oncall-jin.

sre-oncall-jin: acked, joining bridge. looking at metrics and recent deploys.

kevin-eng-runtime: I see a sharp spike starting ~2m ago, p95 -> 4.8s, p99 -> 18s, timeouts increasing. backlog == 42k requests in main queue. logs show provisioner: 429 "quota exceeded" on create.

maria-infra: cloud quota for GPU cores in us-east hit soft cap; request to cloud quota is pending (support ticket #CS-8921). autoscaler retries are being rate-limited by provider.

ops-bot: PagerDuty incident P12345 created, severity: high. Affected customers: 3 platform customers reported >30% timeout increase, no obvious 5xx spike yet.

kevin-eng-runtime: quick mitigation options: 1) enable model-variant fallback to smaller quantized model for hosted tier 2) throttle non-critical routes 3) route heavy customers to dedicated pools if eligible.

emma-cs: I'm seeing support tickets from AcmeCorp and BrightChat about elevated latencies. Sending a quick note: "We're aware and investigating; short-term mitigation in progress".

sre-oncall-jin: implementing 1) and 2) now. Running commands to enable fallback for generation routes.

kevin-eng-runtime: command to flip fallback policy:
```
redwoodctl rollout set --route /v1/generate --fallback-model rwd-small-q4_0 --grace-period 30s
```

sre-oncall-jin: ran rollout command, returned ok. Pushing small-model routing to 20% of traffic as canary.

infra-bot: provisioner logs: "create_node: rate_limited 429, retry_after=60s" repeated 6 times. Pool autoscaler queue depth 0 -> not creating new machines due to provider quota.

maria-infra: Cloud support confirmed request queued; ETA 45-90m for quota bump. We cannot rely on cloud-side fix as immediate mitigation.

kevin-eng-runtime: enabling throttles: reduce per-key QPS for non-SL Tier customers by 30%.

sre-oncall-jin: applied rate limits via feature-toggle: `featurectl set rate_limit non_sl_tier 0.7` — monitoring.

ops-bot: reactions: :thumbsup: on canary. Initial effect: queue dropped from 42k -> 28k in 3m, p95 down to 1.9s, p99 to 7.2s. Some customer errors from long-running batch jobs surfaced.

emma-cs: notified affected enterprise contacts, offered mitigation steps (switch to dedicated or reduce batch sizes). Support is triaging complaints.

kevin-eng-runtime: logs show heavy tail requests pinned to long context lengths. Suggest enabling prefix KV cache for some model variants and trimming max_tokens per-request for hosted tier temporarily.

sre-oncall-jin: toggling max_tokens cap to 1024 for generation endpoints now.

kevin-eng-runtime: command: `redwoodctl config set /v1/generate max_tokens=1024` -> applied.

ops-bot: monitoring: backlog continued to fall to 9k over next 12m, p95 -> 1.2s, p99 -> 3.4s. No new timeouts reported for paying customers.

maria-infra: opening internal postmortem channel and creating runbook ticket for quota handling and preemptive warm pools. Also flagging need for cross-region spares.

sre-oncall-jin: handoff to overnight oncall in 25m. Current state: backlog decreasing, fallbacks at 20%, non-SL throttles in place, max_tokens capped. Cloud quota ETA still 45-90m. Recommend keeping fallback and throttles until quota bump confirmed and backlog <1k.

kevin-eng-runtime: next steps for followup: add automated detection for provider rate_limit errors to trigger immediate fallbacks; add circuit-breaker that reroutes to quantized variants when queue > 5k.

emma-cs: posting a short customer update now: "We've mitigated most of the impact by routing to smaller model variants and applying protective rate limits. We're monitoring and will update when quota is resolved." 

incident-bot: incident P12345 status updated -> monitoring -> next update in 30m.

sre-oncall-jin: leaving bridge, handing to oncall-night. ping me if it flares. :wave:

ops-bot: end of thread summary: immediate mitigations: fallback rollout (20% canary), throttle non-SL traffic (30%), cap max_tokens, customer comms sent. Root cause: cloud GPU quota exhaustion + provider-side rate-limiting preventing autoscaler growth. Action items: quota bump follow-up, implement autoscaler defense vs 429s, circuit-breaker for routing at elevated queue depth.
